title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S03 E07 — La Llorona
The team falls victim to a female Xibalban demon.

title: Debt Collectors
description: Debt collectors French and Sue head to Las Vegas to collect money owed to their boss Tommy, while evading a drug kingpin out for revenge.

title: BloodRayne
description: A vampire hybrid joins the fight against the evil bloodsucker who sired her.

title: BloodRayne 2: Deliverance
description: Beautiful Rayne (Natassia Malthe) teams with demon hunters to save a Western town from a gang of vampiric cowboys led by Billy the Kid (Zack Ward).

title: BloodRayne: The Third Reich
description: Half-vampire, half-human Rayne must stop a Nazi official and his army of walking dead before they can carry out their plan to make Hitler immortal.

title: Duchess
description: Duchess, a small-time crook, tries to enter the treacherous underworld of diamond trafficking and ends up left for dead when a deal goes wrong. Determined to seek retribution she launches into an unwavering pursuit for vengeance.

title: Acts of Violence
description: A man teams up with his ex-military brothers and a detective to save his kidnapped fiancée from human traffickers.

title: Bangkok Dangerous
description: A hitman who's in Bangkok to pull off a series of jobs violates his personal code when he falls for a local woman and bonds with his errand boy.

title: American Sicario
description: American gangster Erik Vasquez schemes to become the top dog in the Mexican underworld, only to find himself making enemies out of both the powerful cartels and his own allies.

title: Primal
description: Hunter and collector Frank Walsh sails to America with a priceless white jaguar and a dangerous political assassin. When the prisoner manages to break free, Walsh must utilize his expert skills to capture the dangerous killer -- not dead, but alive.

title: Dragged Across Concrete
description: Police partners descend into the criminal underworld after they are suspended for assaulting a suspect on video.

title: Eve of Destruction
description: An anti-terrorist (Gregory Hines) hunts a walking bomb made by a scientist (Renée Soutendijk) in her own image, with all of her hang-ups.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S03 E08 — Rio Sangre
Santanico returns with a secret and leads the Geckos to Lord Venganza.

title: Rebel Without a Crew
description:
S01 E08 — Testing Their Limits
Alejandro pushes one of his actors for more, testing her creative limit, and her patience; Josh fights through audio issues and time constraints plaguing his film.

title: Men of War
description: A retired special operations soldier leads a team of mercenaries to an island in the South China Sea to obtain mining rights from the indigenous population.

title: Agent Red
description: A Marine commander (Dolph Lundgren) accompanies a submarine carrying a chemical virus to a secure storage facility.

title: Masters of the Universe
description: Warrior He-Man and his sidekicks seek a cosmic key to free a sorceress from Skeletor.

title: In the Name of the King 2: Two Worlds
description: A former special forces soldier is sent back to medieval times to fulfill a prophecy.

title: Dead Trigger
description: In the near future, a deadly virus has killed billions and turned many others into bloodthirsty zombies. Unable to stop the spread of the virus, the government recruits an elite team to combat the zombie menace.

title: The Defender
description: A bodyguard (Dolph Lundgren) battles an unknown attacker who has ambushed a secret meeting between an American official and a terrorist.

title: Black Water
description: A deep cover operative awakens to find himself imprisoned on a submarine. With the help of a fellow prisoner and an amateur agent, he must race against the clock to escape the vessel and expose who set him up.

title: Machete Kills
description: The president recruits ex-Federale Machete to take down an eccentric arms dealer who plans to spread war and anarchy throughout the world.

title: The Delta Force
description: Terrorists reroute a passenger jet from Athens to Beirut, where commandos (Chuck Norris, Lee Marvin) are waiting to negotiate.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S03 E09 — Matanzas
The Geckos are going after Amaru, as she plots to regain her true form and open the gates of Hell.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S03 E10 — Dark Side of the Sun
As Kate nears death, the team races to defeat Amaru and seal the gate to Xibalba.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S01 E01 — Pilot
Bank robbers Seth and Richie Gecko head for the Mexican border, encountering a deadly standoff at a liquor store along the way; Richie is haunted by visions of demons and a mysterious woman.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S01 E02 — Blood Runs Thick
The Gecko brothers flee the liquor store with Ranger Freddie Gonzalez in pursuit; Richie's visions escalate; the Geckos nearly collide with the Fullers, a troubled family making its own desperate journey to Mexico.

title: The Defender
description: A bodyguard (Dolph Lundgren) battles an unknown attacker who has ambushed a secret meeting between an American official and a terrorist.

title: The Delta Force
description: Terrorists reroute a passenger jet from Athens to Beirut, where commandos (Chuck Norris, Lee Marvin) are waiting to negotiate.

title: The Condemned
description: A death-row inmate from a Central American jail is among the prisoners taken to a remote island for a to-the-death match broadcast live over the Internet.

title: The Condemned 2
description: A former bounty hunter (Randy Orton) lands in a tournament where convicts fight to the death for an online audience.

title: Missing in Action
description: A U.S. colonel (Chuck Norris) escapes from the Viet Cong, then comes back with a floating arsenal to get others out.

title: Missing in Action 2: The Beginning
description: An imprisoned U.S. colonel (Chuck Norris) fights the military overlord (Oh Soon-tek) of a slave-labor opium operation in Vietnam.

title: Braddock: Missing in Action III
description: A U.S. colonel (Chuck Norris) returns to Vietnam and fights his way out with his wife, son (Roland Harrah III) and Amerasian orphans.

title: Cut Bank
description: Things go from bad to worse when a murder witness (Liam Hemsworth) in small-town Montana tries to leverage the crime into a get-rich-quick scheme.

title: Redemption
description: Joey, an alcoholic war veteran assumes a new identity after returning from a traumatic tour in Afghanistan and becomes a vigilante in a bid to atone for his sins.

title: Born to Raise Hell
description: An Interpol Agent (Steven Seagal) and his team investigate weapon trafficking in Eastern Europe when they are caught in a street war between Gypsy gangs and Russians.

title: Nightbreed
description: A young man's quest to end his nightmares leads him to a cemetery where monsters have retreated to escape mankind.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S01 E03 — Mistress
Richie struggles with his visions; Seth makes a plan with Carlos to cross the border; the Fullers suffer an RV breakdown; Ranger Gonzalez seeks help from an expert.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S01 E04 — Let's Get Ramblin'
Seth and Richie take the Fuller family hostage and attempt to leave the motel undetected, but Freddie -- led by the same force that has been guiding Richie -- arrives at their door, igniting a clash that nearly destroys them all.

title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description:
S01 E05 — Self-Contained
After a daring escape from the motel, Seth leads the Fullers' RV to the border crossing; an irrational fear takes hold of Richie; Jacob Fuller takes control of a volatile situation, determined to get his children safely across the border.

title: Meltdown
description: A faded action-star's (Jacky Cheung) bodyguard (Jet Li) saves his reputation and his life during a jewel heist.

title: Duchess
description: Duchess, a small-time crook, tries to enter the treacherous underworld of diamond trafficking and ends up left for dead when a deal goes wrong. Determined to seek retribution she launches into an unwavering pursuit for vengeance.

title: The Boondock Saints
description: Two brothers (Sean Patrick Flanery, Norman Reedus), believing themselves to be on a mission from God, begin killing members of Boston's underworld.

title: Redemption
description: Joey, an alcoholic war veteran assumes a new identity after returning from a traumatic tour in Afghanistan and becomes a vigilante in a bid to atone for his sins.
A desperate man takes part in an underworld game of Russian roulette in which gamblers place bets on who will survive.

title: Contract Killer
description: A fast talker (Eric Tsang) engages a Hong Kong rube (Jet Li) to track down the assassin of a sleazy Japanese businessman.

title: Safe
description: A young girl whose memory holds a priceless numerical code, finds herself pursued. Coming to her aid is an ex-cage fighter whose life was destroyed by the gangsters on Mei's trail.
